Curious about how all departments come together to create an exceptional hotel experience?

At Park Plaza Victoria Amsterdam, every day brings new opportunities to learn and grow. Located opposite Amsterdam Central Station, our iconic hotel welcomes guests from around the world and combines contemporary style with exceptional service.

As a Management Assistant Intern, reporting directly to the General Manager, you will gain exposure to all areas of hotel operations. Supporting projects, coordinating priorities, and collaborating with department heads, you will develop a broad understanding of hotel leadership while contributing to the smooth running of the hotel and an exceptional guest experience.
